custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'vertical cleaver'. In real life, a cleaver cannot stand upright on its spine without support. If the depth auditor confirms no support structure, this is a major structural artifact. Also, scrutinize the 'chopped meat'—AI often fails to render distinct, irregular chunks of minced meat, resulting in muddy textures.
